messages:
maria_cs: FYI - we have a deployment-induced activation latency affecting new tenant activations in eu-west. Seeing stuck 'provisioning' for ~30 tenants.
aj_platform: Acknowledged. Can you confirm the time window and any common config? @ben_se @lily_sre
maria_cs: Started at 08:12 UTC after the rolling deploy. Affected tenants show repeated 502s from onboarding webhook. Commonalities: most are using bulk-import & VPC.
ben_se: I'm seeing increased 503s from dedicated onboarding worker pool. Rolling back 08:05–08:15 deploy may help.
lily_sre: Investigating logs now — KV cache warmup seems to fail on some hosts. Also high GC on worker-3.
deploy-bot: rollback started for release v2.14.3 — job 75432
aj_platform: Nice. CS: we need a short outbound for impacted customers w/ next steps + ETA. Draft below?
olivia_pm: Please include a note about temporary manual retries we can do for high-touch customers. Also offer office hours.
maria_cs: Draft outbound:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We observed activation delays for new tenants in eu-west starting 08:12 UTC after a recent deploy. Our engineers are rolling back the release and performing retries. Impact: activation stuck in "provisioning" for some imports. Next steps: rollback in progress, manual retry for high-touch accounts, estimated recovery within 45–60 minutes. We'll follow up with RCA within 48 hours.
— Maria, Customer Success
```
ben_se: Minor edit: change "rolling back" to "rollback in progress" (present tense). Also add a contact link to support@redwood.ai.
maria_cs: Updated draft and will send to impacted list. Who can own manual retries for top 5 customers? @aj_platform?
aj_platform: Can do two manual retries in next 30m, then coordinate with customers.
lily_sre: Root cause looks like a bad kernel selection path from the deploy; reproducer found. We'll include technical details in RCA.
olivia_pm: Customer ask: will credits be offered? Recommend offering a proactive 10% credit for affected activations, pending legal signoff.
maria_cs: Noted. I'll propose credit offer and get approval from head of CS.
ben_se: ETA for RCA writeup? We can have a preliminary technical summary in 6–12 hours, full RCA in 48.
maria_cs: Thanks. I'll post the outbound at 09:05 UTC to impacted tenants and open an office hours invite for today 11:00 UTC.
aj_platform: Thx team. Keep me posted if any customers escalate. :thumbsup:
